title: Choose the visual world for the BRACU CSE Research Lab slot desk
question: The roll assigned the gamcha check. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Gamcha Check
options.lineage: Bangladeshi handloom gamcha: red, green and indigo stripes crossing on white cotton
options.thesis: The week is woven: PC rows and slot columns are warp and weft, and a booking is where a group's colour crosses.
options.viewport: Madder-red shell bar with a two-stripe check rule; the term's week grid fills the screen, today's live slot runs as a full-height indigo stripe and crosses the selected PC row.
options.risk: The check turns into costume if it spreads beyond the shell rule and the live crossing.

raised.raise: A strict state vocabulary: approved is a solid dyed cell, pending a hollow dashed one, a failed switch a red slip, free stays bare cotton.
Flat colour only: no gradients, shadows or glass anywhere.
One type size inside the grid; rank is weight, case and the single reversed plate on the live cell.
On a phone one PC owns the screen; swipe snaps to the next PC's week.
Every size and gap sits on a 4px step.

options.label: Class Routine
options.lineage: BRACU semester class routine sheet pinned on the department notice board
options.thesis: The schedule set exactly like the routine every student already reads: days across, periods down, codes in cells.
options.viewport: Black-ruled routine grid with day headers and group codes in every booked cell; a blue column marks today.
options.risk: The most familiar route: it is where most runs in this category land and can read as a plain spreadsheet.

options.label: Departure Board
options.thesis: Every PC is a departure row: who is on board now, what leaves next, and which rows are delayed.
options.viewport: Dark board, one row per PC with group, slot and next change in fixed columns; amber rows for pending, red for failed switches.
options.case: Fuses cleanly for the Now page and wins on live status; loses on audience identification and on editing a week grid.
options.risk: A dark board is tiring for long grid-editing sessions at term start.

options.label: Acetate Manual
options.thesis: Sections as coloured divider boards with acetate leaves on top.
options.viewport: A stepped tab rail down the edge, one hue per section.
options.case: Admins and supervisors do not identify with software manuals; leaves obscure a dense grid.
options.risk: Ornamental layering on a working grid.

options.label: Garden Guide Map
options.thesis: Areas as swelling lobes of flat colour.
options.case: Lobes cannot carry a PC-by-slot grid; no audience link.
options.kept: Total commitment to flat, unmodulated colour.
options.risk: Playful shapes undermine trust in enforcement.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.lineage: pocket airline timetables on a light table
options.thesis: One type size; rank by weight, case and reversal.
options.case: Raked containers fight a scannable grid; no audience link.
options.kept: One type size in dense tables, rank carried by weight and reversal.

options.label: Bitmap Specimen
options.thesis: Coarse pixel display type as the aesthetic.
options.case: Poster type is wrong for an operations tool; no audience link.
options.kept: Sizes locked to whole steps of one unit.

options.label: Vertical Feed
options.thesis: One item owns the viewport; snap to the next.
options.viewport: One item fills the screen with a right glyph rail.
options.case: A media feed hides the week-at-a-glance the desk exists for.
options.kept: On phones, one PC owns the screen and swipe snaps between PCs.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A standard SaaS admin: grey sidebar, white tables, one blue accent, executed cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: Left sidebar navigation, page title, a bordered weekly table with blue pills.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every admin template by design.
